profile.name: Yash Kodgirwar
profile.title: Full Stack MERN Developer & AI Systems Specialist

profile.bio: I am an Information Technology undergraduate at G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering and Management, Pune with a CGPA of 9.33/10. Experienced in developing production-grade MERN applications, AI SaaS platforms, and intelligent machine learning forensic systems. Winner of Smart India Hackathon (Internal Round 2025).
profile.availability: Open to Software Engineering & AI Roles

experience.description: Designed and developed AI TraceFinder, an AI-powered forensic system for document forgery detection and scanner source identification using machine learning and deep learning techniques.
highlights: Implemented XGBoost and CNN ensemble models for scanner source identification.
Deployed a Streamlit web application for real-time document authenticity verification and predictive analysis.

education.description: Core Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Database Management Systems (DBMS), Computer Networks, Operating Systems, Machine Learning (Basics).

projects.title: AI Resume Builder
projects.description: Full-stack MERN application with JWT/bcrypt authentication, RESTful APIs, and MongoDB schema supporting dynamic resume templates, custom layouts, and public/private sharing controls. Integrated Gemini-powered AI to enhance resume content and built an image editor with background removal using React Easy Crop and ImageKit.

projects.title: Real-Time Blood Bank & Hospital Coordination System
projects.description: Full-stack platform enabling real-time blood request and response between hospitals and blood banks, improving emergency coordination efficiency. Developed key features including blood inventory management, request tracking, and monthly billing with a scalable backend and responsive UI.

projects.title: Quick.ai — Production-Ready AI SaaS Application
projects.description: Production-ready AI SaaS application serving multiple content-generation and image-processing workflows by integrating LLMs, computer vision APIs, authentication systems, and cloud storage. Features scalable architecture with premium subscriptions, AI-powered resume reviews, and real-time user dashboards.
